# Merge is the default restacking method in this fork.
# Without any configuration, restacking creates a merge commit
# instead of rebasing.

as 'Test User <test@example.com>'
at 2025-06-20T21:28:29Z

cd repo
git init
git commit -m 'Initial commit' --allow-empty

gs repo init
git add feat1.txt
gs branch create feat1 -m 'feat1 commit'

# Create a new commit on trunk
gs branch checkout main
git commit --allow-empty -m 'New trunk commit'

# Restack without configuring a method (should use merge)
gs branch checkout feat1
gs branch restack
stderr 'feat1: restacked on main'

# Verify a merge commit was created (merge was used)
git log --oneline --graph feat1
stdout 'Restack: merge main into feat1'

# Verify the original commit is preserved (not rewritten)
git log --oneline feat1
stdout 'feat1 commit'

-- repo/feat1.txt --
feature 1
